sections.heading: Why Choose It?
sections.text:
✨ Bold 9mm double wheat weave with rich layered texture

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 🌟 Warm 24K gold tone shine with timeless appeal

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 🔒 Secure lobster lock built for confident daily wear

 

 

 
 

 
 

 
 

 📏 23cm length for a comfortable statement fit

sections.heading: How to wear ?
sections.text:
1. Open the lobster lock by pulling back its small lever.

2. Wrap the bracelet around your wrist and hook the lock onto the end ring.

3. Release the lever to snap it shut, and adjust so the weave sits flat.

4. Wipe with a soft dry cloth after wear and store in a dry pouch.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Meet the Double Wheat Bracelet with Lobster Lock – 24K Gold Tone — a bold and sophisticated wrist piece designed with a distinctive double wheat pattern that brings texture, shine and statement appeal together.
The intricate double wheat weave creates a rich, layered texture that catches the light beautifully with every movement. Its 24K gold tone finish adds a warm, luxurious shine while keeping the overall look refined and versatile.
With a bold 9mm width, this bracelet delivers a strong presence on the wrist without compromising its polished appearance. The 23cm length provides a comfortable fit, while the secure lobster lock adds a practical finishing touch for confident everyday styling.

• 
Double wheat design — layered texture with a bold, premium look.

• 
24K gold tone — rich shine with timeless appeal.

• 
9mm width — strong presence and statement styling.

• 
23cm length — comfortable fit with a secure lobster lock.

Wear it solo for a confident statement or pair it with other pieces for a bold layered look. A powerful golden bracelet made for those who prefer their everyday jewellery with extra texture and presence.

sections.heading: FAQ
sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 1. Will the gold tone fade?

With basic care — keeping it away from water, sweat and perfume and storing it in a dry pouch — the 24K gold tone finish keeps its warm shine for a long time.

2. What is the size of this bracelet?

It is 23cm long and 9mm wide — a comfortable fit for most wrists with a bold, statement presence.

3. Is the clasp secure for daily wear?

Yes. The lobster lock snaps shut firmly and holds securely through everyday movement.

4. Is this bracelet suitable for men?

Yes. The bold 9mm double wheat design is made for a strong, masculine wrist presence, worn solo or layered.

5. Can I wear it with a watch or other bracelets?

Absolutely. It pairs beautifully with a watch or other gold-tone pieces for a bold layered look.
